title: Find the commits that introduced and removed a string
notes: skill: git history forensics (pickaxe search over a history with a merged side branch, full shas, author vs committer) without changing the repository; traps: the string in an earlier commit message, a near-duplicate value decoy, introduction on the merged side branch (not the merge), the file renamed later (path-limited search misses it), the string removed and re-added (first introduction asked), a 'Remove R' commit that leaves the definition, root author differs from committer, a case-variant decoy, an unmerged branch with an earlier introduction, an older author date (knob); pass_guess_permille: 480
